conventions.anchor: frame bottom-centre (32,96) on tile bottom-centre; draw at x=tileX*64, y=(tileY+1)*64-96
conventions.frame_advance: by distance travelled: frame = floor(dist_px / px_per_frame) % frames; fps listed is the equivalent at nominal speed
